mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BBS_SURVEY ( SRVY_TTL, SRVY_QITEM, CO_SN, COHORT_SN, SRVY_BGNG_DT, SRVY_END_DT, IS_ANONYMOUS, SRVY_SCOPE, SRVY_TYPE, USER_SN, -- 작성자 FK SRVY_FRST_WRT_DT ) VALUES ( #{dto.srvyTtl}, #{dto.srvyQitem}, #{dto.coSn}, #{dto.cohortSn}, #{dto.srvyBgngDt}, #{dto.srvyEndDt}, #{dto.isAnonymous}, #{dto.srvyScope}, #{dto.srvyType}, #{userSn}, -- AuthCustomUserDetails.getId()로 전달 NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT S.SRVY_SN AS srvySn, S.SRVY_TTL AS srvyTtl, S.SRVY_QITEM AS srvyQitem, S.CO_SN AS coSn, S.COHORT_SN AS cohortSn, S.USER_SN AS userSn, U.USER_NM AS userNm, S.SRVY_BGNG_DT AS srvyBgngDt, S.SRVY_END_DT AS srvyEndDt, S.IS_ANONYMOUS AS isAnonymous, S.SRVY_SCOPE AS srvyScope, S.SRVY_TYPE AS srvyType, S.VIEW_CNT AS viewCnt, S.SRVY_DEL_YN AS srvyDelYn, S.SRVY_FRST_WRT_DT AS srvyFrstWrtDt, S.SRVY_LAST_MDFCN_DT AS srvyLastMdfcnDt FROM TB_BBS_SURVEY S JOIN TB_USER U ON S.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE S.SRVY_SN = #{srvySn} AND S.SRVY_DEL_YN = FALSE

SELECT S.SRVY_SN AS srvySn, S.SRVY_TTL AS srvyTtl, S.SRVY_QITEM AS srvyQitem, S.CO_SN AS coSn, S.COHORT_SN AS cohortSn, U.USER_NM AS userNm, S.SRVY_BGNG_DT AS srvyBgngDt, S.SRVY_END_DT AS srvyEndDt, S.IS_ANONYMOUS AS isAnonymous, S.SRVY_SCOPE AS srvyScope, S.SRVY_TYPE AS srvyType, S.SRVY_STTS AS srvyStts, S.VIEW_CNT AS viewCnt, S.SRVY_DEL_YN AS srvyDelYn, S.SRVY_FRST_WRT_DT AS srvyFrstWrtDt, S.SRVY_LAST_MDFCN_DT AS srvyLastMdfcnDt FROM TB_BBS_SURVEY S JOIN TB_USER U ON S.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE S.CO_SN = #{coSn} AND S.COHORT_SN = #{cohortSn} AND S.SRVY_DEL_YN = FALSE ORDER BY S.SRVY_FRST_WRT_DT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BBS_SURVEY SET SRVY_TTL = #{dto.srvyTtl}, SRVY_QITEM = #{dto.srvyQitem}, CO_SN = #{dto.coSn}, COHORT_SN = #{dto.cohortSn}, SRVY_BGNG_DT = #{dto.srvyBgngDt}, SRVY_END_DT = #{dto.srvyEndDt}, IS_ANONYMOUS = #{dto.isAnonymous}, SRVY_SCOPE = #{dto.srvyScope}, SRVY_TYPE = #{dto.srvyType}, SRVY_LAST_MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE SRVY_SN = #{dto.srvySn} AND USER_SN = #{userSn}
UPDATE TB_BBS_SURVEY SET SRVY_DEL_YN = TRUE, SRVY_LAST_MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE SRVY_SN = #{srvySn}
